title: ticket.closed.v1 payload
description: Payload of the ticket.closed.v1 event, emitted by ticket-service when an appeal is closed. Carries no personal data (docs/06). Closure is an explicit, validated action; a sent response never closes a ticket on its own (docs/01, ADR-006).

closedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the appeal was closed.

retentionUntil.description: Earliest date the appeal becomes eligible for purge (at least five years).
